Nightrider: Deals 1 Electro DMG, summons 1 Oz.
Midnight Phantasmagoria: Deals 4 Electro DMG, deals 2 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters on standby.

description_cn:
清风散花词：造成1点风元素伤害。
朝起鹤云：造成2点风元素伤害，生成「步天梯」，本角色附属「闲云冲击波」。

Word of Wind and Flower: Deals 1 Anemo DMG.

(Characters with Starwicker equipped can use the Technique: Adeptal Assistance)

description_cn:

（角色最多装备1件「圣遗物」）
description_en:
When played: Draw a card.
When the character to which this card is attached is your active character, then when an opposing character takes Reaction DMG: Draw a card. (Once per Round)

When either side uses a Skill: If Elemental DMG was dealt this card gains 1 Qualitative Progress.
When this card gains 3 Qualitative Progress, discard this card, then create 3 different Basic Elemental Dice.

description_cn:

description_en:
When playing a Companion Support Card: Spend 1 less Elemental Die. (Once per Round)
After playing a Companion Support Card: Draw 1 random Companion Support Card from your deck (once per match).

description_cn:
战斗行动：我方出战角色为夜兰时，装备此牌。
夜兰装备此牌后，立刻使用一次萦络纵命索。

（牌组中包含夜兰，才能加入牌组）

Combat Action: When your active character is Yelan, equip this card.
After Yelan equips this card, immediately use Lingering Lifeline once.
Roll Phase: If Yelan, who has this card equipped, is on the field, 1 Elemental Dice will be rolled as Omni Element for each Elemental Type in your party. (Max 3)

description_cn:

菲谢尔装备此牌后，立刻使用一次夜巡影翼。
装备有此牌的菲谢尔生成的「奥兹」，会在菲谢尔「普通攻击」后造成2点雷元素伤害。（需消耗可用次数）
（牌组中包含菲谢尔，才能加入牌组）
description_en:
Combat Action: When your active character is Fischl, equip this card.
After Fischl equips this card, immediately use Nightrider once.
When your Fischl, who has this card equipped, creates an Oz, and after Fischl uses a Normal Attack: Deal 2 Electro DMG. (Consumes Usage(s))

description_cn:

（牌组中包含闲云，才能加入牌组）
description_en:
Combat Action: When your active character is Xianyun, equip this card.
After Xianyun equips this card, immediately use White Clouds at Dawn once.
When you switch characters, this card gains 1 Storm Pinion stack. (Max 2 stacks gained per Round)
When your Xianyun, who has this card equipped, uses Word of Wind and Flower, consume all Storm Pinion stacks. Each consumed stack increases DMG dealt by 1.

（角色最多装备1件「圣遗物」）

（对角色打「天赋」或角色使用技能时：少花费3个元素骰。可用次数：1）

This card will record the number of cards discarded from your Support Zone during this match as Sophistication points. (Max 6 points)
After your characters use an Elemental Burst: If this card has recorded at least 6 Sophistication points, discard this card and attach Sand and Dreams to your active character.
(When the character uses a Talent card or a Skill: Spend 3 fewer Elemental Dice. Usage(s): 1)

我方打出「武器」「圣遗物」「场地」「伙伴」手牌时：如果本场对局中我方曾经打出过所打出牌的同名卡牌，则少花费2个元素骰。（每回合1次）
